title: Product Designer
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers! In this role, you'll: Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature. Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma). Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing. Contribute to Wave's design system and component library. Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective. Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs. Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks). Key details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso. You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You're highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country) 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays $10,000 annual charitable donation matching Requirements Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus. At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps. Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows Attention to detail and high level of visual craft Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects and Lottie at Wave but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions Excellent communication and collaboration skills Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team You might be a good fit if you Are detail-oriented and able to balance multiple projects Can iterate separate concepts quickly to user test design bets. The ability to move fast and update designs based on customer feedback is an important quality we're looking for Think carefully about in-the-weeds details and their role within the design system Feel comfortable anticipating and designing for edge cases Enjoy pairing with designers, engineers, and product managers Are excited to learn about how all our products work together Can speak, read, and write in French. This is nice to have but not a strong requirement - we have large markets in West Africa where French will come in handy. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Engineer II, Chromium
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Security & AI Engineering team. In this role, you will bring strong systems engineering skills—ideally with hands-on Chromium experience across core layers—to build, expand, and harden the runtime capabilities that power Menlo's next-generation AI security platform. You will work at the intersection of browser engine internals, systems architecture, and AI security, expanding our detection surfaces to safeguard enterprise workforces and AI agents against modern threats like Prompt Injection (PI) and Shadow AI usage. The role blends deep C++ browser engineering with work on Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and the cloud infrastructure supporting them. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Chromium, AI, and security disciplines to ship high-performance, evasion-resistant protections, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to move fast while maintaining an uncompromising bar for quality and security. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain Chromium-based browser components in C++, working across layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking, that power Menlo's security and AI-driven capabilities. Architect and embed controls for detecting Prompt Injection (PI) and managing Shadow AI activity directly within browser execution and agent workflows. Apply strong networking fundamentals and HTTP security expertise to harden Menlo's browser isolation, proxy/gateway intercepts, and network-facing infrastructure. Partner with the MARS and AI teams to build and integrate AI agent capabilities and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into Menlo's security platform. Use Python or Rust to build supporting tooling, detection microservices, and prototypes alongside core C++ systems work. Deploy and operate the cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform) needed to run agent/MCP and threat-detection workloads reliably. Debug and optimize performance-critical, high-scale systems across the browser and supporting backend infrastructure. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and AI engineering teams to ship capabilities end-to-end. Apply AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and code review as part of your daily workflow. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in software engineering with strong C++ systems programming skills. Strong networking fundamentals, including solid knowledge of HTTP security, web protocols and / or client-side security architecture. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Preferred / Nice to Have: Experience across Chromium layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking (or equivalent large-scale, high-performance C++ systems experience). Experience or strong interest in AI/LLM security / guardrails domains (e.g., Prompt Injection defense, Shadow AI detection, intent classification, context aware DLP/PII detection, and agentic workflows). Python or Rust experience. Experience building or integrating AI agents, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux. Follow us on LinkedIn ! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability . TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid. title: Account Executive
description: We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙 The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI. We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly. Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. Your core focus will be on full cycle sales from lead generation to closing and onboarding practices. You’ll be joining an ambitious sales team with prior experience at Monzo, Revolut, the Civil Service, the NHS, investment banking, consulting, and other VC-backed startups. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. The role Paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have on growth, and it's about to get a lot bigger. We run Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta today, we're adding new formats and channels, and over the next year we'll be running paid across more markets and across both sides of Dex: the engineers who use it and the companies who hire through it. You'll own our paid channels day to day. You'll decide where the money goes, launch and test campaigns quickly, and judge every channel on the quality of the people it brings in, not on clicks or cheap signups. Creative comes from our in-house creative lead, writers and UGC creators; your job is to brief them well, test what they make and scale what works. This isn't a role where you sit in the ad accounts all week. Once the channels are running well, we want you to take on more: client-side acquisition, new channels, and building your own tools with AI to do the job faster. What you'll do Own Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta: structure, budgets, bidding, audiences and day-to-day optimisation. Launch new campaigns in days, not weeks. Run a steady programme of tests across audiences, formats and landing pages. Judge channels on what matters to Dex: good candidates and the ones who get put forward to clients. Work with our data to make sure conversion tracking and attribution are right, and push quality signals back into the platforms. Brief creative. Work with our creative lead, writers and UGC creators on what to make, tell them what's working and kill what isn't. Open up new channels as we grow, such as YouTube, Performance Max, retargeting and new markets. Help take paid into client acquisition: getting Dex in front of heads of talent, engineering leaders and founders. Manage our paid media agency and any contractors, and bring more of the work in-house over time. Report clearly on spend and results each week, and say plainly what you'd change. Who we're looking for Hands on in performance marketing, managing real budgets yourself across paid search and paid social. Meta and LinkedIn experience matters most. You've worked at a tech company, or you're ready for your first in-house role after a couple of years at a strong agency. You care about what happens after the click. You've optimised for downstream quality, not just cost per lead, and you know how to set up tracking that you trust. Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers, spot when something looks wrong, and explain what's going on without a dashboard doing it for you. You move fast and like owning things. You'd rather ship a test today than plan it for a week. You use AI tools daily, and you're happy building small tools, scripts or agents to do your job better. You don't need to be an engineer. Strong nice-to-haves You've run performance marketing for both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) audiences, ideally at more than one tech company. You've worked closely with a creative studio or run UGC at volume, so you know what a good brief looks like. If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway. Why join now You'll own a channel mix that's growing fast, with the budget and freedom to try things. You'll work on a product people care about. Changing jobs is one of the biggest decisions engineers make, and we want them to trust us with it. You'll work closely with the founders and the Head of Growth, with a lot of room to grow your scope. Everyone here builds with AI. You'll have the tools and the time to work that way. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p>Tripadvisor Experiences is the world's leading marketplace for tours, activities, and experiences. Our mission is to bring more wonder to the world by delivering exceptional experiences to travelers wherever they are. We offer an unparalleled opportunity to be part of the future of the travel experiences industry.</p> <p><br><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, Experiences, the Senior Director of Destination Management leads Viator's global destination management team. You will bring a deep understanding of the global operator community and use it to develop strategies that solve business problems and support our mutual goal with operators: delivering exceptional experiences to travelers. </p> <p>This is an operational role. You will be expected to deliver significant business outcomes by leading and motivating a global team, with decisive leadership and a strong bias for action.</p> <p><em>Job Location: Hybrid</em></p> <p><em>This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 to 3 days per week in our London Office.</em></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>Operator Community and Destination Strategy</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hold a deep, current understanding of the operator community: its needs, economics, competitive options and pain points. Use it to shape how we win and retain supply.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the 3 year destination management strategy and translate it into clear regional charters and measurable KPIs, growing revenue and market share in leading destinations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop strategies that solve business problems for both operators and Viator, in support of delivering exceptional traveler experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own financial rigor: use fresh business data and pacing to steer the business, and help your team understand the financial impact of its decisions and be accountable for it.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Team Leadership and Talent</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as chief architect of the global destination management organization. Lead and mentor Regional Managers, and design an organization and operating model that fits the business as it evolves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set and hold the hiring bar, run rigorous and consistent performance management, and calibrate with peers across Supply.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and retain top talent, and maintain a leadership bench and succession plan for Regional Manager roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set the standard for leadership: humble, open to feedback, and skilled at leading teams through change.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be clear on what each person and region owns, and hold them accountable for it. Push decisions to the lowest appropriate level while stepping in personally on cross-regional or cross-functional problems no one else owns.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Data-Driven Decision Making</p> <ul> <li> <p>Set the standard for hypothesis quality and test design. Define what the team needs to learn, require evidence and experimentation over opinion, and prioritize what operators and travelers actually do over what they say.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Connectivity</p> <ul> <li> <p>Ensure industry-leading connectivity with the features and support operators need. Oversee the connectivity support team and partner with R&D to build enhanced connectivity features.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Innovation and AI</p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive innovation by bringing in outside ideas through industry conferences, councils and competitor insight, and share what works across functions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advocate for and implement AI and automation to transform productivity and quality, including rethinking roles and workflows. Scale proven wins across regions, build team AI skills, and use AI responsibly within our governance and data-privacy guidelines.</p> </li> <li> <p>Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory environments and industry trends affecting supply.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Cross-Functional Collaboration</p> <ul> <li> <p>Align with Supply Sales, Marketing, R&D and Support, and act as an integrator on OKRs and problems that cut across functions, so operators and customers have a seamless end-to-end experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner as one team across Supply and Tripadvisor Experiences, and hold cross-functional partners accountable as well as being held accountable by them.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experi</strong>ence</p> <ul> <li> <p>Global Leadership: 10+ years leading and scaling global teams in market management, account management or a combination, including leading managers of managers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Operator and Marketplace Expertise: Extensive experience with two-sided marketplaces, a deep understanding of supply-side dynamics, technologies and operator communities, ideally in travel.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strategic Thinking: A track record of setting multi-year strategy and turning it into goals, KPIs and results.</p> </li> <li> <p>Operational Excellence: Data-driven operational leadership with a strong bias for action. Skilled at KPIs, pacing and scalable processes to improve global efficiency.</p> </li> <li> <p>Quality Orientation: Experience defining and enforcing quality standards across a catalog or supplier base.</p> </li> <li> <p>Tech Savvy and AI Proficiency: A proven history of using AI and technology to improve business outcomes and create transformational change.</p> </li> <li> <p>Commercial Acumen: Strong commercial and financial acumen, with advanced negotiation and relationship management skills to build and sustain key operator partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Inspirational Leader: An authentic, humble leader who builds trust, develops talent and cultivates a winning culture.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses</li> <li>“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.</li> <li>Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li>Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li>Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li>Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li>Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li>Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li>Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li>Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. </p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. </p> <p><strong>We succeed together</strong></p> <p>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. title: Head of Social
description: About the Role: Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels. You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation. We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed. Tasks Day to day this looks like: Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs. Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community. Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment. Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs. Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel. Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth. Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches. Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy. Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works. Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy. Channel Health: Oversee the overall health and performance of TALA’s social channels, ensuring content is consistent, on-brand and delivering against agreed objectives. You will provide strategic direction while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution. Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business. Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience. Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets. Requirements You should: Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand. Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team. Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce. Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach. Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth. Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn. Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations. Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel. Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts. Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture. Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams. Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment. Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources. Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required. Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth. Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth. Benefits What we can offer: 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays Very generous employee discount after probation period Nominated Friends & Family Discount Clothing allowance spending gift Class Pass or Gym Flex membership Health Shield Enhanced maternity/paternity pay Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000 About us: TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease. When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit. description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. The Internal Communications Lead will build the machine and communications culture that keep Faculty's leadership and teams genuinely connected as we scale - carrying vision, strategy and our worldview on AI to every team undiluted, and surfacing the stories from across the business worth telling This role has two core mandates: 1. Building the internal communications machine - you will design and own how leadership and our teams stay connected day to day - whether live or written, scheduled or ad hoc, and whatever formats a genuinely global, always-on business needs. You will build the architecture - cadence, ownership, structure - so the right message reaches the right people at the right moment, and noise becomes context rather than clutter. 2. Culture, Voice & Connection at Scale - you will be the person who makes sure leadership's vision, strategy and worldview on AI actually reach our teams everywhere, honest and crisp, without being diluted, delayed, or lost in translation as we grow. Leadership owns their voice and their point of view - that stays theirs. Your job is building the stage it's delivered from: sharp, timely, and sensitive to how a message lands differently across cultures and geographies. What you own The voice going down - The communications framework and rhythm that allow the Faculty Leadership to effectively communicate their vision, strategy and worldview on AI to every team, wherever they are in the world, undiluted and on time. The voice from Accenture to Faculty - Point person for relevant Accenture news, updates and requirements that the Faculty teams need to know. The detective work - Some of the best things happening at Faculty aren’t visible from the top. A team quietly solved a hard client problem. Someone's work never got the credit it deserved. A pattern of small wins nobody's connected into a story yet. You go looking for this, building the instincts and the relationships across the business to find the stories worth telling. How we organise ourselves to communicate effectively - The architecture and judgment behind all of it so our people get a clear read of what matters without being buried under what doesn't. What you will be doing Forums & Formats Design the company-wide forums that carry leadership's message, choosing the right format for the right moment rather than defaulting to habit Build for global and cultural nuance from the start, so a message crafted in one office lands with the same weight and clarity in every other Establish a working cadence that respects people's time and attention, so more communication is never mistaken for better communication Channel Architecture & Cadence Own the internal channel architecture, so messages reach the right people without adding to the volume everyone already wades through Set clear ownership of who can broadcast to the whole company, on what, and how often Bring judgement to every leadership message: which forum, format, tone and timing will make it land, and the confidence to say when something needs live delivery, a short note, or nothing broad at all Storytelling & Culture Play detective for the stories that don't naturally surface and give them the visibility they deserve Treat culture preservation as a first-order responsibility of scale, not a side effect of good comms: building formats that carry how Faculty's leaders and teams work together, not just what the business is doing Leadership & Collaboration Where needed, partner closely with leadership as a trusted advisor, protecting their voice while making sure it travels well Establish strong cross-functional relationships across regions and teams to understand what's really happening in the business and shape the internal communications programme around it Support the international expansion of Faculty's internal communications, working with regional colleagues to ensure forums and formats travel well and adapt where they need to What we are looking for Designing the Machine - A track record of designing and building the machine from scratch - cadences, channels, and company-wide forums - rather than simply running an existing playbook. Judgement - A sharp instinct for signal versus noise: what deserves broad visibility, what doesn't, and the confidence to say so to senior stakeholders. Storytelling - A detective's instinct for finding the story in a large, fast-moving organisation, and the ability to tell it with clarity and a genuine point of view. Global & Cultural Fluency - Proven experience communicating across geographies and time zones, with real sensitivity to how messages land differently across cultures and offices. Stakeholder Management - Skilled at working alongside senior leaders and founders, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and discretion. Communication - Exceptional written and verbal skills, able to convey a complex or nuanced leadership message clearly and briefly without losing what made it worth saying. Change & Scale Experience - Experience communicating through a period of fast growth, acquisition, or significant organisational change, ideally in a technical or fast-moving industry. Autonomy & Resilience - Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. About the job Are you someone with a passion for DevOps and are looking to help build and be part of a new Developer Experience team within the Motorway Product & Engineering org? Motorway continues to grow, and we want to provide our developers with the best experience, which is where you come in. We have recently built and rolled out a new container platform on top of AWS Fargate, and are currently enhancing our observability, reliability, and developer-focused tooling. We will continue to build and evolve secure, standardised platform capabilities that reduce cognitive load and help teams ship faster with confidence. This is an exciting time to join, the team is new and the company growing which presents opportunities to do things “right” to set up success for the org into the future. What you'll do Own and evolve our AWS environments and shared platform infrastructure, focusing on reliability, scalability, and ease of use for product teams. Design and build opinionated, self-service tooling that makes it easy for engineers to build, deploy, and operate services correctly. Continuously reduce manual work (toil) by automating common workflows and standardising infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and platform abstractions. Define and implement platform-level monitoring and alerting standards that provide meaningful signals without overwhelming teams. Enable product teams to use shared metrics and signals to understand and improve the reliability of their services across environments. Own and evolve our continuous delivery and release capabilities, reducing time to production while maintaining high standards of reliability and safety. Stay current with best practices in application hosting, continuous delivery, and developer experience, and apply them pragmatically to the platform. Upskill and mentor other engineers in the team. You’ll use your judgement to make trade-offs, anticipate failure modes, and help the team avoid repeating past mistakes. Requirements Proven track record of owning and operating web platforms in production at scale. Strong experience with AWS in a production environment. Experience defining meaningful metrics, monitoring, and alerting for web platforms, with a strong intuition for actionable vs noisy signals. Experience working with platform-level security controls and observability, including identifying and responding to abnormal or unsafe system behaviour. Experience designing and operating continuous delivery systems that support safe, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments. Experience responding to production incidents in an on-call environment and improving systems based on what you learn. Comfortable with command-line tools and environments. Proficient with at least one programming language used for automation or tooling. Enjoy solving complex, cross-cutting problems in collaboration with engineers across the organisation Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements and priorities. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3><strong>Your Impact</strong></h3> <p>The HR Director will serve as a strategic partner to Axon’s Chief Revenue Officer and provide leadership within the Global Sales organization across a broad spectrum of HR disciplines including Talent Development, Org Effectiveness, Executive Coaching, Compensation, and Employee Relations. title: Account Executive
description: Account Executive EU GTM | London, United Kingdom About the team Join our high-energy team in London and help us bring smarter payment solutions to growing businesses across the UK and Europe. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower merchants by making payments simple, accessible, and hassle-free. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we're just getting started. As an Account Executive, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team driving growth and helping business owners with £50k+ in revenue access the tools they need to succeed. What you'll do Proactively identify and reach out to prospects via calls, emails, and social — you'll be the one starting the conversation Build strong relationships by understanding the unique needs of each business and showing how SumUp can make a real difference Go on-site to meet prospects and clients in person — building trust face-to-face and delivering demos that convert Deliver value-driven product pitches and demos that help convert curiosity into commitment Own the full sales cycle — from first outreach to deal closed Track your performance, meet your goals, and continuously level up through feedback and data Share insights, collaborate with your team, and help build an energised outbound culture in the office You'll be great for this role if… You have 1–2 years of outbound sales or business development experience — and a drive to learn and grow fast in the role. You're confident, curious, and comfortable with high-volume outreach (mostly phone-based). You love solving problems and helping people. You're results-driven and thrive on smashing targets. You bring a positive, team-first attitude and enjoy celebrating wins with your colleagues. Bonus: Experience in payment tech, SaaS, or hospitality tools is a big plus. Why you should join SumUp 💸 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission — your earning potential grows with your success! ✅ A foot in the fintech door — work for a global brand that's scaling fast and be part of a mission-driven team with real impact 🏢 Office-first culture in Central London — collaborate face-to-face with a fun, supportive team and stay connected to the energy of live sales 📚 €2,000 annual learning budget — invest in your development with training, events, or courses that support your goals 🧘 Sabbatical after 3 years — take a well-earned 30-day break to reset or pursue something meaningful 🌍 Diverse and inclusive workplace — be part of a team that values different perspectives and creates space for everyone to thrive 🔗 Referral bonus — help grow the team by referring talented friends or former colleagues and get rewarded for it About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform. Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines. A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas and problems into straightforward, actionable recommendations, especially to executives. Even better… SQL experience. Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools. Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience. Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it. Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>Experience Without Limits</strong><br><strong>Come shape the future of brand experience.</strong></h3> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>At Jack Morton, we design and build<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong>head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>unlock the full value of experiences</strong> by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one.</strong> We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.</p></div><p>The Account Executive will support the assigned Account Management team and a portfolio of clients. This person should be well organised, have a keen eye for numbers and be highly computer literate, adept at using software platforms including Microsoft Office, CRM’s and finance platforms.</p> title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement & Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.</p> <p>• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.</p> <p><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <p>• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity</p> <p>• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences</p> <p>• Commercially minded</p> <p>• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels</p> <p>• Naturally curious and innovative</p> <p>• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader</p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications & Skills:</strong></p> <p>• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams</p> <p>• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing</p> <p>• Experience leading teams and developing talent</p> <p>• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing</p> <p>• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)</p> <p>• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics</p> <p>• SQL and data querying experience preferred</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?</strong></p> <p>Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
description: <h4><strong>About the job</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.<br>Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.<br><br>You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.<br><br>You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.</p> <h4><strong>The team and culture</strong></h4> <p>The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.</p> <h4><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h4> <h4>Essential skills:</h4> <ul> <li>Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.</li> <li>The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.</li> <li>Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.</li> <li>Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.</li> <li>Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.</li> <li>Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.</li> <li>Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.</li> <li>Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong> Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br><br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><br><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></h4> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.<br><br>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Apply to join Graphcore’s AI Compute Libraries team in Bristol.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. </p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. </p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. </p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><span title: Senior Product Manager, Prediction Markets
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.</p> <p>Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.</p> <p>Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. We have a small, high-performing team and a very flat structure to ensure the best ideas win.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager who is highly nimble and can solve a wide range of problems across the entire product stack. You’ll come in, understand the problem, define a solution, ship, iterate and move on to the next problem. Here are some example problems you might solve:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Building the best perpetual futures product for a sports-first trader</p> </li> <li> <p>Building a “pro” trading mode for our best customers</p> </li> <li> <p>Building industry-first tools that help traders make better decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Building new types of rewards and incentives for traders</p> </li> <li> <p>Whatever else you come up with to drive trading volume and grow the business</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll need</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>2–6 years’ experience in Product Management</p> </li> <li> <p>A love of numbers – you think in probabilities and make data-driven decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills, both written and verbal</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering amazing products to end customers</p> </li> <li> <p>An entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort with basic trading concepts and familiar with top platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Hyperliquid.</p> </li> <li> <p>You move fast</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience in fintech  or building a trading product</p> </li> <li> <p>A STEM background or quantitative degree<br><br>#LI-LS2<br><br></p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£70,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£93,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
